description: This script manages post-installation tasks for bundled plugins in a software project. It discovers runtime dependencies, checks if certain conditions are met, and automates the installation of missing dependencies after installation. It also includes utility functions for environment setup and dependency detection.

methods.name: readJson
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON file from the given filepath.

methods.name: dependencySentinelPath
methods.description: Constructs the path to the dependency's package.json in node_modules.

methods.name: collectRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Combines dependencies and optionalDependencies from package.json.

methods.name: discoverBundledPluginRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Discovers runtime dependencies for bundled plugins by reading extension directories.

methods.name: createNestedNpmInstallEnv
methods.description: Creates a modified environment object for npm install, removing certain configs.

methods.name: isSourceCheckoutRoot
methods.description: Determines if the current package root is a source checkout by checking for git and src directories.

methods.name: shouldRunBundledPluginPostinstall
methods.description: Checks whether to proceed with postinstall based on environment variables and directory structure.

methods.name: runBundledPluginPostinstall
methods.description: Main function that performs post-installation tasks such as installing missing dependencies for plugins.
